restaurantName: The Tea Room at Burnham Beeches
bio: Why not enjoy Afternoon Tea in quintessential surroundings in The Tea Room at Burnham Beeches? Built in 1727, this elegant manor house is nestled within 10 acres of beautiful gardens in Buckinghamshire, providing guests with the utmost tranquility.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Tea Room, where classic & contemporary design blend effortlessly with culinary excellence.  Using the finest quality ingredients, Burnham Beeches Hotel handcrafts a mouth-watering selection of sandwiches, cakes and scones, beautifully presented on a three-tier plate.
pageTitle: The Tea Room at Burnham Beeches
